note: Every lap FastF1 recorded, including safety-car, VSC, red-flag, in- and out-laps. lap_time_s is null where no lap time was recorded; render the gap, do not drop the row. clean=false means the lap was excluded from model fitting, not that it is wrong.

circuit.source: FP1 position telemetry; validated pre-race reference line

conditions_basis.weather: Latest sensor at or before lap completion; maximum age 180 s
conditions_basis.traffic: Past-position sample-and-hold on validated pre-race geometry; metric 20 m off-line gate; at least 50% lap coverage
conditions_basis.missing: Null means unavailable, not zero. No carcass temperature or pressure feed.
conditions_basis.animation: Schematic motion on measured geometry; not continuous live GPS
